description: Eneba BR Sim → Cloudflare Turnstile — dual-plane objective diagnostic
humanNotes: Requires lab UI + Projected client (npm run lab:eneba-turnstile).
Virtual click Sim via evaluate; probe.turnstile captures live DOM + table + iso + nestedPeek.
Verdicts: turnstile.* in verdicts.json; artifact probes/turnstile-diagnostic.json.

params.expression: (() => { const norm = (s) => (s ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().toLowerCase(); const candidates = [...document.querySelectorAll('button, a, [role="button"], input[type="button"], input[type="submit"]')]; let sim = candidates.find((el) => norm(el.textContent) === 'sim' || norm(el.value) === 'sim'); if (!sim) { sim = candidates.find((el) => norm(el.textContent).includes('sim') && norm(el.textContent).length < 12); } if (!sim) { const labels = candidates.slice(0, 40).map((el) => norm(el.textContent) || norm(el.value) || el.tagName).join('|'); throw new Error('Sim button not found; sample=' + labels); } sim.click(); return JSON.stringify({ clicked: true, tag: sim.tagName, text: norm(sim.textContent) || norm(sim.value) }); })()
